newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso rises on late dip in dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso rises on late dip in dollar demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso rose 0.85 to 1,074.6 against the dollar on a late dip on demand for greenbacks, interbank traders said.
Markets picked up again Wednesday after a thin session Tuesday -- the first day of an indefinite, nationwide public sector strike.
"There was good demand for the dollar early on, but that failed to soak up the flow of export earnings into the market later in the session," one trader said.
Traders reported 387 deals worth a total $159 million, compared to just $48 million the day before. The peso opened at 1,075.5, sank to an intraday low of 1,077.5 and hit an intraday high of 1,074.
